references.name: Whitney
references.mechanism: Artwork proportions determine remaining space; institution follows art.
references.application: Dawn actual wide/portrait images produce different area proportions; fixed caption/identity rail.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.

references.name: Philbrook
references.mechanism: Identity aperture reveals collection; modular organization supports browsing.
references.application: Dawn full-image reading aperture; real image stays intact and selector changes actual object.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.
references.decision: Use museum source data, not their P

references.name: Hood
references.mechanism: Brick geometry unifies building, publication and web; letters embedded in facade.
references.application: Exact V04 B copy: shared engraving field extends behind scripture and actual model, original six-bay recess at the transition to worship information.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.

references.name: Serpentine
references.mechanism: Opening and connecting space are one relationship.
references.application: Church retains scripture and architecture as two openings in one field; P2 fixed square anchors remain unedited.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.
references.decision: No imported logo or P2 motion edits

references.name: MIT Media Lab
references.mechanism: Shared geometric system yields distinct group marks.
references.application: Wall shows four confirmed original rhythms and three explicitly provisional mappings; continuous natural widths, monochrome, micro and reverse comparisons.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.
references.decision: No false historical attribution or approval

references.name: Poster House
references.mechanism: Identity recedes to a movable edge.
references.application: Journal original end mark as page-edge imprint and column closure; not a giant arrow replacement.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.

references.name: Cooper Hewitt
references.mechanism: Flexible editorial operations vary by content.
references.application: Journal actual four movements/twelve columns, distinct editorial structure; compare Dawn work-specific reading field.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.

references.name: MoMA
references.mechanism: One artwork dominates; identity placement stays stable.
references.application: Journal actual original poster and issue text; Dawn full photo with secondary reading information.
references.license_or_rights: Design method only; no reference graphics copied.
